The AI layer is a 3,837,028-parameter multi-label neural network (v3 architecture: 2,560 hashed bag-of-tokens + 48 engineered features → 1152 → 576 → 288 → 4 outputs) trained offline by distilling expert security heuristics into the network, then int8-quantized and embedded in this page. Inference runs 100% locally — no data leaves your browser. It complements, and does not replace, the rule-based findings.
◆ What's new in v3
  • AI risk engine — 3,837,028 parameters (2.37M in v2, 1.5M in v1): 2608 → 1152 → 576 → 288 → 4, retrained and re-verified (AUC ~1.00 on all heads, quantized accuracy ≥ 99.7%).
  • 6 new checks — layout tables, missing canonical URL, autoplaying media, generic "click here" link text, empty links/buttons, password-field autocomplete hints.
  • Everything from v2 — SRI & supply-chain checks, unsandboxed iframes, CLS, form labels, meta-refresh, scan history (localStorage) — plus all v1 checks.

⚠ Use this tool only on websites you own or have explicit permission to test. This is a passive, browser-side scanner — it fetches publicly reachable pages only and cannot replace a full penetration test.
